'''70,000''' ('''seventy thousand''') is the [[natural number]] that comes after [[60,000#69,000 to 69,999|69,999]] and before 70,001. It is a round number.

==Selected numbers in the range 70001–79999==
* '''70030''' = largest number of digits of [[pi|π]] that have been recited from memory

* '''71656''' = pentagonal pyramidal number

* '''72771''' = 3 x 127 x 191, is a [[sphenic number]],<ref>{{cite OEIS|A007304|Sphenic numbers: products of 3 distinct primes}}</ref> [[triangular number]],<ref>{{cite OEIS|A000217|2=Triangular numbers: a(n) = binomial(n+1,2) = n*(n+1)/2 = 0 + 1 + 2 + ... + n}}</ref> and [[hexagonal number]].<ref>{{cite OEIS|A000384|2=Hexagonal numbers: a(n) = n*(2*n-1)}}</ref>

* '''73296''' = is the smallest number ''n'', for which ''n''&minus;3, ''n''&minus;2, ''n''&minus;1, ''n''+1, ''n''+2, ''n''+3 are all [[Sphenic number]].
* '''73440''' = 15 × 16 × 17 × 18 (can also be written as [[factorial|18!]] ÷ 14! or {{sfrac|18!|14!}})
* '''73712''' = number of [[Eight queens puzzle|''n''-Queens Problem]] solutions for ''n'' = 13
* '''73728''' = 3-[[smooth number]]

* '''74353''' = Friedman prime
* '''74897''' = Friedman prime

* '''75025''' = Fibonacci number,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000045|title=Sloane's A000045 : Fibonacci numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref> Markov number<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002559|title=Sloane's A002559 : Markoff (or Markov) numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''75175''' = number of partitions of 44 <ref>{{cite OEIS|A000041|a(n) is the number of partitions of n (the partition numbers).}}</ref>
* '''75361''' = Carmichael number<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002997|title=Sloane's A002997 : Carmichael numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>

* '''76084''' = amicable number with 63020
* '''76424''' = tetranacci number<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000078|title=Sloane's A000078 : Tetranacci numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>

* '''77778''' = Kaprekar number<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A006886|title=Sloane's A006886 : Kaprekar numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>

* '''78163''' = Friedman prime
* '''78498''' = the number of primes under 1,000,000
* '''78557''' = conjectured to be the smallest [[Sierpiński number]]
* '''78732''' = 3-[[smooth number]]

===Primes===
There are 902 prime numbers between 70000 and 80000.
